note: Ask 3: `we also should consider applying fix-its automatically in the HLSL rewriters`. Scored against dxr.exe (compiler id main-debug-rw), not dxc.exe. Clause 1 proves the rewriter ran and emitted a rewrite; clauses 2 and 3 prove it computed the same fix-it hint dxc does; clause 4 is what the rewrite actually contains -- the declaration with the diagnosed initialiser dropped, rather than replaced by the suggested text. All four are positive, so nothing here is satisfied by a run that failed early. Control: `rewriter-control` runs the identical dxr command over control-fixed.hlsl, whose initialiser is valid; it must score no-match. That control is load-bearing -- without it, `the initialiser disappeared` would be indistinguishable from `this rewriter drops every initialiser`, which is a claim about the rewriter in general and not about fix-its.
